judgments.wholeCompetence: One functionality–structure–property–use explanation comparing the three explicitly required silicone families, not three unrelated name lists.
judgments.case1: M/D/T have respectively1/2/3 hydrolysable groups. Me2SiCl2+2H2O gives Me2Si(OH)2+2HCl; local SiOH condensation gives SiOSi+H2O. A oil, B resin and C rubber follow from the given connectivity and service behaviour. Increased T creates a meaningful network-density transfer; no universal property constants are asserted.
judgments.case2: Alkoxysilane hydrolysis releases EtOH rather than HCl. The new precursor and specified moisture-curing system require a real chemical transfer. Dry conditions may inhibit the specified hydrolytic activation; this is not proof that all silicones need moisture, that direct silanol/alkoxy condensation is impossible, or that all resins have a universal temperature rating.
judgments.profile: All four required expectations cover manufacture, functionality, all three families and changed conditions. Supplied formulas/data are complete for the stated theoretical task. No practical execution or recalled industrial numbers are added as universal duties.
judgments.source: HB34 optional Vertiefung, GK/LK eligible, only when the silicone deepening is selected. Actual manufacture/constitution/properties/use and all three families are preserved. This is not the separate HB19 general macromolecule-formation obligation and does not grant whole2652 source closure.
judgments.atomicity: A common causal comparison is assessed by one explanation chain. Different examples of network connectivity are its objects; no semantic split needed.
judgments.memory: no_memory_needed: all M/D/T precursor roles and quality observations are supplied. Transfer derives connectivity and performance; existing polymer/bonding prerequisites remain distinct.

judgments.wholeCompetence: Transparent multidimensional classification of organic colourants, including azo and two further selected structural classes; no synthesis-mechanism claim.
judgments.case1: A aromatic azo linkage, B triarylmethyl cation and C glycosylated flavylium are distinguishable with the actual inline cards. Structure, medium-specific solubility, origin, textile method and use are kept separate. Missing textile methods for ink and indicator are correctly reported. Identical synthetic C changes origin without changing molecular class or proving safety.
judgments.case2: Azo pigment P versus sulfonated dissolved P-prime changes molecular substitution and stated application; colour class and synthetic origin persist. Q and R supply new class representatives. Given solubility and declared textile suitability are not general properties of all azo compounds. This is a genuine changed-case classification.
judgments.profile: All four expectations require class features, independent classification axes and justified reassignment. Both whole cases include complete structural class cards; no absent full stereochemical structure asset is promised. Detailed case exemplars do not create a synthesis duty.
judgments.source: RP47 selected6.2 Leistungsfach Additum: at least two additional classes are explicit; mechanisms for these further classes are explicitly unnecessary. The separate azo-synthesis mechanism in the adjacent source clause remains a separate obligation. No automatic all-GK or default-course selection is granted.
judgments.atomicity: A single criterion-consistent classification competence uses multiple axes and objects; it is not a conjunction of synthesis, analysis and experimental skills.
judgments.memory: no_memory_needed: complete defining features and provenance/use cards are supplied. Correct reasons and new classification, rather than isolated colourant names, are assessed.

judgments.wholeCompetence: A local valence/charge-correct urethane-formation mechanism linked to repeated bifunctional polyaddition without a small eliminated molecule.
judgments.case1: Alcohol O lone pair attacks electrophilic NCO carbon; C=N pi electrons move to N. The formal R-N-minus-C(=O)-O-plus(H)-R-prime intermediate conserves valence and charge. B/BH-plus mediates O deprotonation and N protonation, regenerating B and giving RNHCOOR-prime. The displayed two-urethane segment retains two NCO ends. Partial ethanol replacement caps ends despite equal OH counts.
judgments.case2: Aromatic diisocyanate/propane-1,3-diol retains the local electron-pair logic; complete ethanol replacement gives a bisurethane, not the long chain. Correcting N attack, water elimination and an equation-only account makes the transfer substantive. The formally simplified mechanism is expressly not a unique or dominant microscopic-path claim.
judgments.profile: All four whole-goal aspects require actual arrows/charges, proton relay, repeated linking and functional-group transfer. Complete inline donor/acceptor/helper information supports the theoretical task. No experimental handling of hazardous isocyanate or kinetic-rate prediction is requested.
judgments.source: RP65 optional Vertiefungs-/Verzahnungsmöglichkeit Mechanismus der Polyaddition, GK/LK eligible when selected. Urethane is a legitimate explicit mechanism example; this is not an unconditional new course obligation or a claim to cover every polyadduct.
judgments.atomicity: The local mechanism and its repeated bifunctional linking are one coherent explanation, distinct from the prior broad overall polymer equation/control goal.
judgments.memory: no_memory_needed: lone-pair direction, valence, charge and group functionality support derivation. Memorising a fixed arrow picture would not replace the changed-reagent reasoning.

judgments.wholeCompetence: Explain actual film fixing by residual AgBr dissolution through Ag(I) complexation, separated from exposure, development and the metallic silver image.
judgments.case1: AgBr(s)+2S2O3(2-)(aq) gives [Ag(S2O3)2](3-)(aq)+Br(-)(aq); each side has Ag1 Br1 S4 O6 and total charge-4. Ag remains+I. Given1mmol AgBr consumes2mmol ligand from6mmol, leaving4mmol. Metallic Ag(0) remains under the stated model. A water-only rinse is a qualitative changed-composition transfer; it does not fix equivalently.
judgments.case2: The specified free-ligand capacity regime changes from excess to limiting:1.2/2=0.6mmol maximum AgBr removal from0.8, leaving at least0.2mmol in that model. This is not merely a number swap because residual photosensitivity and the effect of a fresh bath change. Silver remains in the removed soluble complex. Explicit exclusion of other species makes this a bounded capacity model, not a real fixing-time or universal speciation prediction.
judgments.profile: All four expectations connect substance/particle explanation, balanced ionic chemistry, image preservation and meaningful medium/capacity changes. Thiosulfate and complex formulas are actually supplied. A theoretical explanation does not claim the separate adjacent practical fixing/solubility experiment.
judgments.source: SN physical41/printed29, Jahrgang11 GK, selected photography Wahlbereich1 only. The original AgBr-complexation clause is supported; neighbouring actual silver-halide solubility/fixing experiments and environmental handling are retained as separate source duties, not silently covered by these data tasks.
judgments.atomicity: Substance and particle levels plus necessary separation from image formation explain one fixing process. They do not introduce independent exposure/development performance goals.
judgments.memory: no_memory_needed: ligand identity, complex stoichiometry and film model are supplied. The competence is dissolution reasoning and changed material balance, not recall of a new formula deck.

judgments.wholeCompetence: Compare conditions of radical chain polymerisation, polycondensation and polyaddition by their group reactions and controlled process constraints.
judgments.case1: Styrene initiation/C=C growth, acid-diol polyester formation with water removal, and dry NCO/OH urethane addition are all compared explicitly. The supplied70/240/25C examples are not class constants. Initiator supplies radicals; catalyst changes the path and equilibrium approach, not K at fixed temperature. Moisture consumes NCO and may generate CO2, whereas retained product water affects condensation.
judgments.case2: Photoinitiated methacrylate at20C and interfacial amine/acid-chloride polycondensation at20C are chemically different from hot case1 and each other. Light absence, HCl capture/amine protonation and NCO-water side reaction give real changed conditions. HCl scavenger is correctly not called a regenerated catalyst. The data provide no complete kinetic or industrial-safety performance claim.
judgments.profile: All four expectations require all three routes, initiation/catalysis and temperature, process control and meaningful comparison under changed chemistry. No missing apparatus, learner execution or universal numerical recall is implied.
judgments.source: TH physical58/printed53 right column additional elevated level: comparing Reaktionsbedingungen is compulsory LK. All three routes stay in the comparison. This does not replace adjacent polymer/monomer-structure comparison or actual polymer manufacture obligations.
judgments.atomicity: A single comparative reasoning operation links three prerequisite routes across the same condition axes. The individual syntheses are prerequisites, not repeated independent new goals.
judgments.memory: no_memory_needed: all specific conditions are supplied. Their reasons and bounds must be inferred; universal temperature/catalyst numbers must not be fabricated as a recall duty.
